package rulefixtures

import (
	"errors"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for panic_for_expected_errors: `panic()` used for expected error conditions like invalid input or missing config
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: warning.
type User struct {
	ID   int    `gorm:"primaryKey"`
	Name string `gorm:"column:name"`
}

func FindUserByID(db *gorm.DB, id int) *User {
	var user User
	err := db.First(&user, id).Error
	if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
		panic("user not found")
	}
	return &user
}

func GetConfigValue(key string) string {
	config := map[string]string{"db_host": "localhost"}
	val, ok := config[key]
	if !ok {
		panic("missing required config: " + key)
	}
	return val
}
